xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2603: feat(docs-rag): complete (or retire) the docs RAG integration — PAN-1203 shipped lib-only

plan.title: feat(docs-rag): complete the docs RAG integration (keep decision)
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: PAN-1203 shipped a complete docs-RAG library (src/lib/docs/: corpus, index-builder, query, gate/budget/telemetry state) plus the pan docs CLI, config schema, and build wiring — but the feature is dead end-to-end. Root defect: the index builder writes <packageRoot>/dist/docs-index.sqlite while the query layer reads ~/.overdeck/docs/index.sqlite (getDocsIndexPath), and nothing bridges them, so pan docs query silently returns nothing (queryDocsIndex swallows all errors). Additionally the UserPromptSubmit injection was never wired: evaluateDocsPromptGate/recordDocsInjection/recordDocsTelemetry have zero callers, and no ops doc exists. NOTE: the issue's claims 'zero callers' and 'build not wired' were verified WRONG — the pan docs CLI is registered (src/cli/index.ts:609) and npm run build runs build:docs-index via scripts/build-post-cli.mjs:18 unless SKIP_DOCS_INDEX=1.
narratives.Proposal: KEEP and finish the integration with the smallest correct delta. (1) pan docs reindex builds the index in-process directly at the live path getDocsIndexPath(); (2) scripts/build-docs-index.mjs additionally copies its dist artifact to the live path; (3) new thin service src/lib/docs/injection.ts (buildDocsInjectionContext) composes gate → query → budget bump + telemetry → <overdeck-docs> markdown block; (4) POST /api/memory/inject (postMemoryInjectRoute in src/dashboard/server/routes/hooks.ts) calls the service in its fast synchronous path only and appends the block to the returned context — the existing UserPromptSubmit hook already prints that context to stdout, so no hook-script change is needed; (5) pan docs query prints a stderr hint when the index file is missing; (6) docs/DOCS-RAG.md ops doc + PAN-1203 PRD status update. Full implementation brief with before/after snippets: drafts/pan-2603.md on overdeck-state.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No Pi or codex harness injection — Claude Code UserPromptSubmit only
- No 'pan docs status' subcommand (PAN-1203 wanted it; PAN-2603 does not)
- No re-enabling the docs-index build in CI/release and no prebuilt index shipped in the npm package — SKIP_DOCS_INDEX posture in ci.yml, release.yml, and launcher-generator.ts stays exactly as is
- No fallback read paths in queryDocsIndex (single canonical live index path; materialization is fixed at the writers)
- No classifier fallback work (docs.classifier stays enabled:false) and no trigger-regex tuning
- No corpus expansion, cross-repo RAG, or dashboard UI surface
- No removal of the dist artifact path (DEFAULT_DOCS_INDEX_PATH) — packaging optionality is preserved

autoDecisions.summary: Decision gate resolved as KEEP, not kill.
autoDecisions.rationale: The kill rationale in the issue ('lib has zero callers, so this is clean') is factually wrong — the pan docs CLI is registered, src/index.ts exports the lib, build wiring exists, and the agent briefing already advertises 'pan docs query'. The lib+gate+config+tests are complete; finishing costs ~5 small beads while killing would rip out a CLI command, config schema, briefing references, and skills.

autoDecisions.summary: Injection wired server-side into the /api/memory/inject fast path rather than a hook-side 'pan docs query' shell call.
autoDecisions.rationale: The hook already POSTs there with the prompt and prints returned context to stdout (sync-sources/hooks/user-prompt-submit-hook:47-54); a hook-side CLI call would add Node cold-start latency to every prompt submit and violate the hook's 1s curl budget. Matches the established memory-injection pattern.

autoDecisions.summary: Index materialization fixed at the writers (reindex + build script) targeting the existing live path ~/.overdeck/docs/index.sqlite; query layer untouched.
autoDecisions.rationale: Single source of truth for reads; adding a dist-path fallback in queryDocsIndex would be a bandaid chain, which the repo's no-bandaids rule forbids.

autoDecisions.summary: SKIP_DOCS_INDEX posture unchanged; docs RAG remains a source-checkout-only feature.
autoDecisions.rationale: Release CI deliberately skips the heavy index build (PAN-1659) and the npm package ships neither docs/ nor skills/ corpus, so package-based installs cannot use docs RAG regardless. Re-litigating that costs release-pipeline weight this issue doesn't need.

autoDecisions.summary: Empty query results do not consume injection budget.
autoDecisions.rationale: Budget exists to cap injected tokens; a no-op injection spends nothing and should not lock out the next genuinely useful injection within the rate window.

items.title: pan docs reindex builds in-process to the live index path

narrative.Action: Replace the reindex action in src/cli/commands/docs.ts (currently spawns 'node scripts/build-docs-index.mjs', lines 52-62) with an in-process call: buildDocsIndex({ outputPath: getDocsIndexPath(), rootDir: packageRoot, maxIndexBytes: DEFAULT_DOCS_INDEX_MAX_BYTES }) importing from ../../lib/docs/index-builder.js and ../../lib/paths.js, then log the result path/chunkCount/sizeBytes. buildDocsIndex already does tmp-file + atomic rename. If the action closure is hard to test directly, extract an exported runDocsReindex(overrides?) helper and have the action call it. Tests MUST inject a fake embedding provider (copy the pattern in src/lib/docs/__tests__/index-builder.test.ts — never download the gte-small model) and use a temp docsDir/indexPath override. Exact before/after snippets: WI-1 in drafts/pan-2603.md on overdeck-state.

Thin injection service: buildDocsInjectionContext in src/lib/docs/injection.ts

expected_outputs: injection.test.ts passes with all six scenario tests

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/docs/injection.ts exporting buildDocsInjectionContext(options: { prompt; sessionId?; projectPath?; config?; paths?: DocsPathOverrides; now?: Date }): Promise<{ injected: boolean; context: string | null; reason?: DocsGateReason }>. Order: (1) evaluateDocsPromptGate (src/lib/docs/state.ts:95) — if shouldInject is false, return { injected:false, context:null, reason } with NO budget bump and NO telemetry; (2) queryDocsIndex({ query: prompt, config, indexPath: paths?.indexPath }) — if zero results, return { injected:false, context:null } with NO budget bump (empty injection must not consume the rate window); (3) otherwise recordDocsInjection (state.ts:133) + recordDocsTelemetry (state.ts:184), return { injected:true, context: formatDocsQueryMarkdown(result) }. Never throw: wrap the body in try/catch returning { injected:false, context:null } — the hook route must never 500 because of docs. Re-export the module from src/index.ts next to the other lib/docs exports (lines 10-13). API shape and test matrix: WI-3 in drafts/pan-2603.md on overdeck-state.

items.title: Given a fixture index (fake embeddings) and a trigger-matching prompt, buildDocsInjectionContext returns injected:true with context containing '<overdeck-docs>' and advances the budget state file exactly once

When docs are disabled (config enabled:false or a disable-scope entry) or the prompt matches no trigger regex, it returns injected:false with the gate's reason and writes no budget or telemetry entries
When the budget is exhausted for the session key, it returns injected:false with reason 'budget_exhausted' and does not query telemetry-bump
When the index file is missing or the query returns zero results, it returns injected:false without throwing and WITHOUT advancing budget state
When an injection succeeds, the service records exactly one JSONL entry at the telemetry path override
Wire docs injection into the /api/memory/inject fast path

expected_outputs: hooks-docs-inject.test.ts passes all four route-level scenarios

narrative.Action: In src/dashboard/server/routes/hooks.ts, inside postMemoryInjectRoute (line 259) ONLY: after warningResult is computed in the fast synchronous path (~line 276) and before the 202 jsonResponse (~line 293), call buildDocsInjectionContext({ prompt, sessionId, config: loadConfigSync().config.docs }) (loadConfigSync from src/lib/config-yaml/load.ts:417; prompt/sessionId already parsed from the request body) and join a non-null docs context onto the response context with '\n\n'. CRITICAL (H3 in continue.json): do NOT put docs logic inside handleMemoryInjectBody — that function runs a second time fire-and-forget at ~line 289 and would double-bump budget and double-write telemetry. Add a test seam for config/paths mirroring how the route already injects injectMemory/injectBriefing for tests. Model the new test file on src/dashboard/server/routes/__tests__/hooks-user-prompt.test.ts; fixture index built with fake embeddings (H2); assert the fixture returns rows via queryDocsIndex before asserting route behavior (H5). Full spec: WI-4 in drafts/pan-2603.md on overdeck-state.

items.title: Given a fixture index and an Overdeck-trigger prompt, POST /api/memory/inject returns 202 with a context field containing '<overdeck-docs>'
With docs.promptInjectionEnabled:false or a non-trigger prompt, the response context contains no '<overdeck-docs>' block and existing memory/compliance context is preserved unchanged
With the index file missing, the route still returns { ok: true } at 202 with no docs block (docs failure never breaks the hook)
Given one injecting request, the docs budget state file records exactly one injection entry — proving the fire-and-forget second handleMemoryInjectBody call performs no docs work
pan docs query prints a stderr hint when the index file is absent

expected_outputs: docs.test.ts passes including the missing-index hint test

narrative.Action: In the query action of src/cli/commands/docs.ts, before calling queryDocsIndex, resolve the index path as options.indexPath ?? getDocsIndexPath() and, if the file does not exist (existsSync), print to stderr: "No docs index found at <path>. Run 'pan docs reindex' to build it." Then continue to the normal empty-result output on stdout and exit 0 (stdout contract unchanged so scripted consumers are unaffected). Add no new flags — skills/pan-docs must not drift (scripts/lint-skills.sh runs in npm run lint). Shares a test file with reindex-live-path; sequenced after it to avoid same-file merge conflicts.

items.title: With no index file at the resolved path, 'pan docs query x' writes the hint naming the resolved path and 'pan docs reindex' to stderr and exits 0
When an index is present, the command prints no hint to stderr and preserves the existing stdout output byte-for-byte
